question: Why is Christian Watson scoring so many fantasy points this season?
answer:
Christian Watson's 19.8 PPR points per game average is inflated by strong early-season opportunity (25.8% target share, 82% snap share in weeks 1-3), but his overall production has declined significantly. Target share fell to 18.6% and snap share to 78.7% in weeks 4-6, causing PPR points per game to drop from 23.1 to 16.5. Although his touchdown efficiency (30.3% of PPR points on 6 TDs) and red-zone target share (20%) provide scoring volume, the clear decline in opportunity and production outweighs this efficiency. His yards per target improved from 10.6 to 13.9 and air yards share rose from 30% to 34.8%, indicating upside, but the drop in target share and PPR points per game confirms he is not currently a reliable starter. Verdict: hold Christian Watson.
